headline: Ishan Dyes and Chemicals files AGM voting results
hook: Ishan Dyes concludes annual shareholder voting
summary: Ishan Dyes and Chemicals Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report following its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026. The company has officially filed the voting results with the NSE. This is a routine procedural compliance filing.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
